title: Search multiple indices with combined results in one hits area
body:
Through Algolia's API I can see that [it is possible to query multiple indices](https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-client/javascript/search/#search-multiple-indices).
But is it possible to have two sets of results ranked against each other?

The main use case is, you have two indexes of data with different properties, but you want to give the user the ability to see results from both **and ranked against each other** (this is key). 

You could add multiple indexes when configuring instant search:
```
instantsearch({
  appId: config.appId,
  apiKey: config.apiKey,
  indexNames: ['index1','index2'] 
});
```
Now each query would apply a search to both, and return a combined result that ranks them against each other.

I'm sure there are complications in being able to rank two different structures against each other, but often you have very different data sets and want to embed along with them some other kind of data.

One example would be, you have an index of web pages, and you have an index of company locations.
You want a user to be able to search the web pages for specific content, but if their search matches company locations, you want to highlight those in order of relevance to other web page results to the user.

Could something like this be done by creating a custom instantsearch widget where you manually combined two sets of results in some fashion?
